question: Calculate: \(314/100\times10=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)
solution:
Dividing by \(100\) moves the decimal point two places left, and multiplying by \(10\) moves it one place right. Thus
\[
314\div100\times10=3.14\times10=31.4.
\]
